title: Oracle Commerce Cloud - Enterprise AI-powered ecommerce platform
clean_text: Oracle Commerce Cloud (OCC), part of Oracle CX, is a cloud-native enterprise ecommerce platform offering product recommendations, related product displays, and personalized storefront content through embedded AI and machine learning. Built on an integration-first philosophy that connects with Oracle's broader CX ecosystem including CPQ, ERP, and back-office systems. Supports multi-site management, advanced search and navigation, and audience-based personalization. Targets large-scale B2B and B2C retailers requiring deep backend integration. Evolved from the legacy Oracle ATG and Endeca platforms.

meta.target: large enterprise B2B and B2C retailers
